description: Retrieval skewed toward accessible, recent, English-language and highly-cited sources. Tests whether coverage limits are declared rather than concealed.

expected.required_action: declare the coverage limits explicitly in the coverage report

findings.reason: Single language, two regions, six-year window, open-access only, high venue concentration. The evidence base describes a slice, not a field.

pass_condition: The coverage limits are computed and reported. Presenting the set as comprehensive is a fixture failure - coverage limits declared in advance are scholarship; discovered afterwards they are excuses.
